market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$81-82K on May 6, requires ~8-9% drop to touch $75K with ~25 days left. Trend is bullish (3-month highs); analyst floor for May is around $73-76K. A pullback to $75K is possible on macro shocks but counter-trend; probability ~20-30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Risk-off event or Iran flare-up could trigger a pullback to support.
